U1.cue: At kick-off, pass back to the edge of the circle. If their back line is still high, play a lobbed through ball over it.
U1.setting: Striker on Advanced Forward (Attack), so he makes the run in behind.
U1.n: FC 26 made this harder. Since update 1.0.3 the defending team sits more compact for a short time after kick-off, and update 1.1.0 made its markers tighter at kick-off. Only go over the top if their line is still high.

src.t: EA 1.0.3 notes: more compact after kick-off
EA 1.1.0 notes: tighter marking at kick-off

U2.n: Since update 1.4.0 (January 2026) AI defenders react slower when marking the ball carrier, so space opens while they turn.

src.t: EA Title Update 1.4.0: AI defenders react slower

U3.n: EA gives no block-reach number for FC 26. It did make the Fake Shot 5% faster in update 1.5.0.

src.t: EA Title Update 1.5.0: Fake Shot made faster

U4.n: FIFA 23’s driven lobbed through (LB + RB + Y) is gone. In FC 26 that combo plays a driven ground through ball. Use LB + Y to go over the top.

src.t: FIFPlay: FC 26 controls

U5.n: EA made chip shots more accurate and less likely to go wide in update 1.5.0. FC 26 keepers also make smarter one-on-one choices, so chip only once he commits.

src.t: EA Title Update 1.5.0: chip shots more accurate
EA Gameplay Deep Dive: keepers in one-on-ones

U6.cue: A defender a few yards off, standing between you and the keeper? Shoot now, low. He is too far off to block it.
U6.n: Squad Battles uses Competitive gameplay, and EA lists “fewer auto tackles and auto blocks” there. In FC 26 a low driven shot is a double-tap of B. EA made them less accurate at extreme power, so don’t max it.

src.t: EA Gameplay Deep Dive: fewer auto blocks; double-tap for low driven

U7.n: FC 26 adds Controlled Sprint (hold RB) to keep the ball close. Against two men closing in, still pass first.

src.t: Red Bull: quick, first-time passing is one of FC 26’s strongest attacks

A1.n: Since update 1.4.0 the Squad Battles CPU moves the ball forward quicker instead of keeping it.

src.t: EA Title Update 1.4.0: the Squad Battles CPU attacks quicker

A2.n: Update 1.1.3 made the CPU dribble with sharper turns. EA also made jockey more responsive (1.1.0) and tackles from behind less effective, so stay in front of him.

src.t: EA 1.1.3 notes: the CPU dribbles with sharper turns
EA 1.1.0: jockey more responsive

A3.n: EA lowered cross height in update 1.3.0, so crosses arrive flatter. Get the near post covered early.

src.t: EA 1.3.0 notes: lower crosses

A4.n: Since update 1.2.0 AI defenders, your teammates included, mark the edge of the box less tightly. Nobody closes that runner unless you do.

src.t: EA 1.2.0 notes: looser marking at the edge of the box

A5.n: Chip shots got more accurate in update 1.5.0, so a keeper who charges all the way gets punished. The halfway tip itself comes from FIFA 23 guides.

src.t: EA Title Update 1.5.0: chip shots more accurate
Sportskeeda (FIFA 23): bring the keeper halfway

A6.n: A player tip on EA’s forums: the FC 26 Squad Battles AI “seems to really struggle with counter attacks”. It was written before update 1.4.0 made the CPU attack more, which leaves even more space behind.

src.t: EA forums, player tip: the AI struggles with counter attacks
EA Title Update 1.4.0: the CPU attacks more

B1.setting: One central midfielder as Deep-Lying Playmaker (Build-Up), so there is always a pass in front of your CBs.
B1.n: FC 26 has no Player Instructions. Each player’s Role and Focus decide where he goes.

src.t: EA (FC 25 FC IQ, still used in FC 26): instructions replaced by Roles

C1.setting: FC 26 has no edge-of-box instruction. Roles decide who arrives, so look back for the late man.
C1.n: Since update 1.2.0 AI defenders mark the edge of their box less tightly, so the cutback man has more room. For a faster ball: LB + RB + X, X (driven ground cross).

src.t: EA 1.2.0 notes: looser marking at the edge of the box
EarlyGame (German): driven ground cross for cutbacks

C4.n: Aim the through ball at the gap between two defenders. In FC 26, semi-assisted through balls pick the runner in that lane.

src.t: EA Gameplay Deep Dive: passing lanes for through balls

C5.n: EA made one-touch shots more responsive in FC 26’s Competitive gameplay, which Squad Battles uses.

src.t: EA FUT Deep Dive: more responsive one-touch shooting

D2.n: In FC 26, hold A only contains if Defending is set to Tactical in your controller settings. On the default, Advanced, hold A is a physical tackle.

src.t: EA: FC 26 settings guide (Defending: Advanced, Tactical, Legacy)

D4.n: In FC 26, hold A only contains if Defending is set to Tactical in your controller settings. On the default, Advanced, hold A is a physical tackle.

src.t: EA: FC 26 settings guide (Defending: Advanced, Tactical, Legacy)

SAY26.Blocked. CPU defenders block anything wi: Blocked. He was close enough to get a foot to it.
SAY26.He is within a yard, so he would block i: He is right on you, so he would block it. Fake it first.
SAY26.He’s too far off to block it, and he’s i: He’s too far off to block it.
Shoot now. Low driven, far post.
Go now, while their defenders are still turning.
Gap behind you. That’s the pass it looks for.
SAY26.On Ultimate, some CPU players get +10 to: Since update 1.1.3 the CPU dribbles with sharper turns.
SAY26.The CPU loves to cross. Now your box is: The cross is coming. Now your box is short a defender.
A chip punishes this. Chips got more accurate in update 1.5.0.
Go now. Lobbed through over their last two.
SAY26.Pivot on Stay Back While Attacking. Alwa: Pivot as a Deep-Lying Playmaker. Always a pass in front of the CBs.

FB26.s5: Everyone shifted to the ball, so the far side is empty. Switch it: X, or LB + RB + X for a driven one.
FB26.s11: Their pressers are behind you and still turning. Drive forward with RT and attack the space.
FB26.s13: He is close enough to block it. Fake shot first (B then A), then shoot with space.
FB26.s16: Your CB stepped out and left a gap. Since update 1.4.0 the Squad Battles CPU goes forward quicker. Hold your line and switch (LB) to the CB nearest the runner.
FB26.s17: Their midfielder arrives late at the edge of your box. In FC 26 your AI teammates mark the edge loosely, so close him yourself while the pass travels.
FB26.s18: Everyone shifted to the ball, so their far winger is free. A long switch is on. Keep your far full-back close enough to step out.
FB26.s19: Their winger has the touchline. Get your full-back goal-side, jockey him outside, and keep your CBs in the box.
FB26.s21: Chip shots got more accurate in FC 26 update 1.5.0, so a keeper who charges all the way gets chipped. Bring him halfway and make the striker decide.
FB26.s22: No space ahead and two of them closing. Sprinting into them loses it. Pass, then move into space.
FB26.s23: He’s too far off to block it. Shoot now: low driven (double-tap B) to the far post.
